summary: Red Bull reasserts its dominance threat after Bahrain practice, with George Russell and Charles Leclerc acknowledging the Milton Keynes squad as the weekend's team to beat. Ferrari and Mercedes clash for the secondary podium positions while drivers battle extreme heat conditions in the third heat-hazard classification of the season. A strong Red Bull performance could widen their championship cushion significantly, making this race pivotal in determining the title's trajectory heading into the final stretch.
